extension.summary: Fullscreen XMLTV programme guide with channel and stream mapping.
extension.description: Maintained modernization Beta of TV Guide Fullscreen: XMLTV listings, stream mappings, search, reminders and ordinary AutoPlay. Stream Setup tabs show their contents in Default, Dark and CatBar, including Browse and Addons. Thanks for the major contributions from: iainmacleod, im85288, RayW1986, bluezed, andy, Zomboided, tycoo, kjb86, Doctor-Eggs
extension.disclaimer: Based on the original TV Guide addon by twinther, FTV Guide and Midraal's fork.
extension.news: 0.1.3 Beta prepared, pending owner publication: same-path XMLTV refresh with saved guide settings and mappings retained; subtitle and strict category-scoped search; native Favorites return; category mouse interaction and membership order. Fresh XMLTV declaration order applies unless explicit M3U ordering is enabled; saved weights and visibility stay. Ordinary title misses in #86 remain open. Planned for Nexus/Omega; Matrix startup remains blocked and Piers is preview-only. Versioned ZIP native qualification is pending.
